title: Daraz.pk Product Scraper
description: Scrape Daraz.pk product listings from category URLs or a search query. Collect prices, discounts, ratings, reviews, stock state, seller details, and product links.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Daraz.pk category or catalog listing URLs. When supplied, these are used and searchQuery is ignored.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Product search keywords, used when no start URLs are supplied. Defaults to "dress" so a run with no other input still returns products.

maxProducts.title: Maximum Products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to save. Set to 0 for unlimited.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages to request per URL or search query.

includeOutOfStock.title: Include Out of Stock
includeOutOfStock.description: Include products that are currently out of stock.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Leave empty to connect directly. For scheduled or large runs, use Apify Proxy with residential sessions in Pakistan so the Actor can rotate to a fresh address when the site limits the current one. Apify Proxy requires a run on the Apify platform.
